description: A theoretically exact plane, point, or axis from which a dimensional measurement is made and tolerances are established.
The condition where a feature of size contains the maximum amount of material within the stated limits of size (e.g., largest pin or smallest hole).
The condition where a feature of size contains the least amount of material within the stated limits of size (e.g., smallest pin or largest hole).
Condition where an element of a surface, or an derived median line, is a perfectly straight line.
Condition of a surface having all of its elements residing in one perfectly flat plane.
Condition of a surface of revolution where all points intersected by a plane perpendicular to the axis are equidistant from that axis.
Condition of a surface of revolution in which all points of the surface are exactly equidistant from a common axis.
When used without datums, it controls the 2D form (shape) of a specific linear cross-section.
When used without datums, it controls the 3D form (shape) of an entire surface.
Condition of a surface or feature's center plane/axis that is exactly equidistant at all points from a datum.
Condition of a surface, feature's center plane, or axis at an exact 90° right angle to a datum.
Condition of a surface, center plane, or axis at any specified theoretical angle from a datum.
Defines a zone within which the center, axis, or center plane of a feature is permitted to vary from its theoretically exact location.
Condition where the median points of all diametrically opposed elements of a figure are congruent with the axis of a datum.
Condition where the median points of opposed elements of two or more surfaces are congruent with a datum center plane.
When used with datums, it controls not only the 2D form but also the orientation and/or location of a linear feature.
When used with datums, it controls the 3D form, orientation, and location of an entire surface.
Provides control of circular elements of a surface, evaluated independently at each circular cross-section, as the part is rotated 360°.
Provides composite control of all surface elements simultaneously across the entire surface as the part is rotated 360°.
